IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
                                FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
                                           Alexandria Division


   MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE                                 )
                                                          )
                                                          )
                   Plaintiff,                             )
                                                          )
   v.                                                     )   Civil Action No. 1:26-cv-2331-(RDA/IDD)
                                                          )
   KATIE HALL, et al.,                                    )
                                                          )
                                                          )
                   Defendants.                            )
                                                          )

                                                  ORDER

        This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave under Federal Rule of Civil

Procedure 26(d)(1) For Leave to Serve Four Limited Interrogatories on Meta Platforms, Inc. Before the

Rule 26(f) Conference [Dkt. No. 54] (“Motion”). This matter can be resolved without oral argument, as

such argument would not aid the decisional process. Upon consideration of Motion, it is hereby

        ORDERED that the September 25, 2026 Motion Hearing on Plaintiff’s Motion at 10:00 AM in

Courtroom 301 is TERMINATED. The undersigned deems a Motion hearing is not necessary and will

resolve Plaintiff’s Motion on the papers; It is further

        ORDERED that pursuant to Local Civil Rule 7(E) Defendant Meta Platforms, Inc.’s Response

to Plaintiff’s Motion is due no later than September 17, 2026, and Plaintiff’s Reply is due no later than

September 23, 2026; It is further

        ORDERED that, should any party utilize generative artificial intelligence for the preparation of

any filing submitted to this Court, that party must identify the use of the generative artificial intelligence

in the filing as well as provide a certification that said party has reviewed all citations for accuracy.

        The Clerk is directed to forward a copy of this Order to all counsel of record.

        ENTERED this 10th day of September 2026.

/s/
                       Ivan D. Davis
Alexandria, Virginia   United States Magistrate Judge
